verses.text: And there was a man from the hill country of Ephraim, and his name [was] Micah.

verses.text: And he said to his mother, “The thousand and a hundred [shekels] of silver that were taken from you, and on which you put a curse, and even saying it in my ears, here [is] the silver with me. I took it.” And his mother said, “Blessed [is] my son of YHWH!”

verses.text: And he returned the thousand and a hundred [shekels] of silver to his mother, and his mother said, “I wholly dedicate the silver to YHWH from my hand for my son to make a carved image and a molten image. And now I will return it to you.”
